description: Run check settings once from one location, without saving anything, and return the result with its timings. Free. Use it before edge_create_pulse_check to confirm the target answers the way the check expects.

config.description: Settings beyond the target, merged over it; needed for api checks. http: method, headers, body, followRedirects, expectStatus (list of codes), bodyContains, expectHeaders, verifyTls. dns: recordType, resolver, expectValues. ssl: port, serverName. tcp and udp: send, expect. ping: count. api: steps (list of { url, method, headers, body, expectStatus, bodyContains, assertJson, extract }) and variables.

location.description: A location id to run from (from edge_list_pulse_locations). Default: any one.

target.description: What to watch, in one line. http and browser: a URL. dns: "example.com" or "example.com MX". ssl: "example.com" or "example.com:8443". tcp and udp: "db.example.com:5432". ping: a host.

type.description: http: a URL. api: a workflow of requests. ssl: a certificate. dns: a record. tcp, udp: a port. ping: a host. browser: page speed in a real browser (needs a card on file).

name: edge_test_pulse_check
